decision: Adopt the staged architecture and retain FastAPI plus sandboxed TeX. This branch implements the first validated latency and recovery migration; the full roadmap is not complete.
baseline_equivalence: Committed orchestrator.py and job_routes.py are unchanged between the proposal reference and the worktree main base, verified with git diff.
implemented: Atomic Redis admission metadata, state, sequence, replay, Pub/Sub and user index in one round trip; existing admission and terminal evidence preserved.
Bounded shielded async broker submissions in 14 API engine and cleanup paths; existing payload and ACK recovery semantics retained.
Redis pool reuse by PID, URL and password with periodic health checks; Modal initialization passes its configured password.

Ordered bounded compiler and model content publication, pipelining unchanged per-event ownership and cancellation Lua gates. Epoch captured before thread handoff; oversized token deltas split without text loss.
Throttled noisy-loop cancellation reads, independent process watchdog, synchronous read-confinement inspection and terminal flush barriers.
Exact tenant-scoped rendering cache shared by direct and combined compilation, complete prepared source/settings/image epoch keys, render-only restoration and post-finalization population.
Atomic fenced per-job optimization requesting/completed checkpoints. Render retries reuse completed LLM output; ambiguous, missing, corrupt or replaced checkpoints prevent automatic repayment.

Default-off compact literal-bullet optimization: source/node revision checks, linear projection, ordered protected vocabulary and punctuation, Unicode control rejection, conservative macro fallback and byte-preserving application.
Compact one-request input/output budgets, no SDK retries, pre-header deadline watchdog and cancellation boundaries. Expired output is rejected; transport cancellation is best effort.
Deterministic original-case JD keyword extraction; ATS scoring failures return unavailable instead of zero.
Previous PDF remains visible during replacement; pending export and source/PDF sync blocked. Immediate and reconnect REST recovery backs off after initial fast polls.
PDF_RENDER_PAINT telemetry measures artifact-ready to first-page paint, excluding download and compile, without document identifiers or source.

RESUME_STAGE_CHECKPOINTS_ENABLED.scope: Lifecycle-owned combined jobs; 24-hour Redis recovery, not a durable database stage ledger.

RESUME_COMPACT_PATCHES_ENABLED.scope: Supported literal single-line itemize bullets under simple section headings. Unsupported source uses the legacy optimizer before any compact paid request. No substantive rewrite or semantic factual-proof claim.

independent_review_fixes: Same-word factual reversals such as revenue from 10 to 20 becoming 20 to 10: ordered relation, number, negation and punctuation guards.
Quadratic blank-heavy source projection: linear reverse next-nonempty index, with 50,000-line regression coverage.
Legacy asynchronous ownership epoch drift: freeze once before handoff.
Unicode visual controls and xparse command/environment ambiguity: reject unsafe nodes and preserve opaque source.
Per-chunk Redis cancellation overhead: throttle with mandatory boundary checks.
Header wait outside watchdog: arm before SDK request creation.
Completed paid stage repeated after rendering failure: fenced exact-context checkpoint recovery.
Large provider delta exceeding queue bounds: split token payload while preserving exact concatenation.

validation.backend: 470 tests passed across 18 selected Linux suites: 423 renderer, sandbox, lifecycle, cache, admission, compact, checkpoint and dispatch tests against freshly created isolated Redis/Postgres migrated through 0058, plus 47 observability and legacy LLM streaming tests. Collection count independently verified. No live AI calls.
validation.frontend: 35 tests passed; TypeScript and targeted ESLint passed.
validation.python: Ruff passed on touched source, new tests and benchmark scripts.
validation.real_tex: 200 paired measured samples plus warmups across ordinary and verbose fixtures. PDF headers, normalized extracted text and page counts matched; hostile input and real infinite TeX loop protections passed. Original blocked-order experiment retained separately.
unverified: Production end-to-end latency, cold-start/region/load tails and browser first paint.
Live provider quality/cost and all-template/language coverage of experimental compact patches.
The full product regression suite outside selected engine and dispatch paths.

benchmarks.interpretation: Local admission component measurement; real warm TeX with explicitly simulated Redis RTT on a shared host. Ordinary zero-RTT medians were mixed. No production or sub-second guarantee.

remaining_architecture_phases: Complete distributed user-action-to-first-paint spans and real deployment baselines.
Revision-scoped early artifact.ready API/client contract, durable immutable binary manifests, pre-dispatch authorized cache and duplicate-request leases.
Per-document auxiliary workspaces, certified template pass policies and latest-revision preview scheduling with explicit entitlement policy.
Persistent semantic document identities, builder adapters, cached factual/job-requirement context and evidence ledger.
Provider capability adapters, substantive patch quality evaluation, bounded parallel planning, effort/token/cost budgets and durable database stage recovery.
Exact-PDF semantic overlay editing and accepted/candidate branch contracts.
Warm capacity/region tuning and alternative renderer experiments after measured target gates.
deployment: Not deployed, merged or pushed. Compact patches remain disabled pending quality/provider benchmarks.
